topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Finding my old teddy bear at a yard sale, of all places, stirred something I hadn’t expected. The fur, now a bit threadbare and sun-faded, held whispers of wistful memories. It was odd, holding a piece of my past that I thought had long since vanished. The threadbare paws and the glassy, unseeing eyes seemed to stare into a different time, one where life’s concerns were as simple as losing a toy. Yet, here we were, the bear and I, both somehow surviving the relentless march of years. It's a curious thing, to reconnect with a kidnapped fragment of innocence, amidst the clutter of a stranger's sale. I wonder, what else might be lingering, lost in the spaces between the days?
